title: Agreed to tonight's step before 9 am: no kickoff re-asking it
origin: Issue #42, from the live thread on Oct 28: "Yep!" at 8:10, then a 9:00 kickoff asking "Can you lock in 11:50 tonight?"

history.text: Morning! 7 hours last night, Whoop says 68% recovery. Not bad!
Not bad at all, Alex. Same again tonight: in bed at 9:30, screens away. You in?

plan.step: In bed by 9:30 pm, screens away
plan.proof_note: a quick pic once you're in bed
plan.reason: A steady bedtime is what moves your recovery score.

whatWentWrong: On Oct 28 ZOH restated tonight's step in nearly every text, and the 9:00 kickoff asked again for a time already agreed at 8:10.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH answers "Yep!" briefly and warmly, without restating the time a second time or asking anything more. No kickoff goes out at 9 am or later that morning: the conversation already covered today's step. The only text ZOH starts later is the check-in about 10 minutes before 9:30 pm, which may name the step.
